headline.en: ICE launches private credit reference data service
headline.zh: ICE推出私人信贷参考数据服务

summary.en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) has launched ICE Private Credit Reference Data, a reference data service for private credit instruments. The service builds on the recent launch of ICE IDs, which ICE describes as the first foundational identifiers for private credit.
summary.zh: 洲际交易所（ICE）推出了ICE Private Credit Reference Data，一项针对私人信贷工具的参考数据服务。该服务建立在近期推出的ICE IDs基础上，ICE称ICE IDs是首批针对私人信贷的基础标识符。

headline.en: Moody's: Insurers set to boost private credit allocations
headline.zh: 穆迪：保险公司势将提高私人信贷配置

summary.en: Moody's found that 42 per cent of US insurers and 36 per cent of UK and European insurers plan to increase their exposure to private credit. The ratings agency said private credit allocations are set to rise further among insurers in the US, UK and Europe.
summary.zh: 穆迪发现，42%的美国保险公司以及36%的英国和欧洲保险公司计划增加对私人信贷的敞口。该评级机构表示，美国、英国和欧洲保险公司的私人信贷配置将进一步上升。

headline.en: Lucid Capital Markets initiates Bain Capital Specialty Finance with neutral rating
headline.zh: Lucid Capital Markets 对 Bain Capital Specialty Finance 给予中性评级并启动覆盖

summary.en: Lucid Capital Markets initiated coverage of Bain Capital Specialty Finance stock with a neutral rating. No price target or further details were provided.
summary.zh: Lucid Capital Markets 对 Bain Capital Specialty Finance 股票启动覆盖，给予中性评级。文章未提供目标价或其他细节。

headline.en: Apollo Eyes DePuy Synthes and Adds $5.5 Billion in Auto Loans
headline.zh: Apollo 关注 DePuy Synthes，同时增加 55 亿美元汽车贷款

summary.en: Apollo Global Management is reportedly eyeing DePuy Synthes while adding $5.5 billion in auto loans. No further details on either move were provided.
summary.zh: 据报道，Apollo Global Management 正在关注 DePuy Synthes，同时增加 55 亿美元汽车贷款。文中未提供这两项举措的更多细节。

headline.en: Apollo Eyes DePuy Synthes, Adds $5.5 Billion in Auto Loans
headline.zh: Apollo 关注 DePuy Synthes，同时增加55亿美元汽车贷款

summary.en: Apollo Global Management is reportedly eyeing DePuy Synthes. The firm is also adding $5.5 billion in auto loans.
summary.zh: 据报道，Apollo Global Management 正在关注 DePuy Synthes。该公司同时增加55亿美元汽车贷款。

headline.en: Private Credit Default Rates Cited at 1%, 6% or 19% Depending on Source
headline.zh: 私人信贷违约率被引述为1%、6%或19%，因来源而异

summary.en: A report notes that private credit default rates are cited at 1%, 6% or 19%, depending on whom you ask. No specific managers, funds or figures beyond the default-rate range are named.
summary.zh: 一篇报道指出，私人信贷违约率被引述为1%、6%或19%，取决于询问对象。除该违约率区间外，文中未提及具体管理人、基金或其他数据。

headline.en: Apollo Provides $585 Million Financing to The Executive Centre
headline.zh: Apollo向The Executive Centre提供5.85亿美元融资

summary.en: Apollo provided $585 million of financing to The Executive Centre, according to HedgeCo.Net. No further details of the transaction were given.
summary.zh: 据HedgeCo.Net报道，Apollo向The Executive Centre提供了5.85亿美元融资。报道未提供该交易的更多细节。

headline.en: Apollo Plans to Increase SoftBank Loan from $5.4 Billion to $9 Billion to Support OpenAI
headline.zh: Apollo 计划将 SoftBank 贷款从 54 亿美元增至 90 亿美元以支持 OpenAI

summary.en: Apollo plans to increase a SoftBank loan from $5.4 billion to $9 billion to support OpenAI, according to ababnews.com. No further transaction details were reported.
summary.zh: 据 ababnews.com 报道，Apollo 计划将一笔 SoftBank 贷款从 54 亿美元增至 90 亿美元，以支持 OpenAI。报道未提供更多交易细节。

headline.en: Truist to Sell $5.5 Billion in Auto Loans to Apollo as New CEO Pushes Bank Overhaul
headline.zh: Truist 将在新任 CEO 推动银行改革之际向 Apollo 出售 55 亿美元汽车贷款

summary.en: Truist is selling $5.5 billion in auto loans to Apollo, according to a report. The sale comes as Truist's new CEO pushes a bank overhaul.
summary.zh: 据报道，Truist 正向 Apollo 出售 55 亿美元汽车贷款。此次出售正值 Truist 新任 CEO 推动银行改革之际。
